evidence.source_statement: After the 100 percent completion of a project, phase, milestone, task or feature has been reported once, omit it from later routine progress reports while preserving the underlying roadmap and completion history.
source_conditions: An item's 100 percent completion was already announced in an earlier report.
source_exceptions: This does not erase archived completion data; explicitly reopened work may be reported as incomplete.

interpretation.situation_scope: Relationships describe relevant contexts, not exhaustive triggers or narrower rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Intent relationships describe inferred underlying outcomes; normative authority remains with the original rule.
interpretation.effective_rules: No rule, rule profile, or execution instruction is altered by linking.
